definition: Tools of the trade are items that a person needs to pursue their occupation. These are instruments, tools, equipment, devices, and machinery as would be usually used in the normal course and scope of a person's profession, trade, or occupation without the use of additional labor. For example, an electrician would have pliers, electrical tape, etc. Tools of trade are exempt property - that is, they may not be seized by creditors or by the trustee in a bankruptcy case - either entirely or up to a certain dollar amount.
